primary_claim: 16 agents have lower handoff loss per layer than 8; T16<T8 on every seed. If no second crew forms, or it forms without lower loss, the proposed crew mechanism fails.
metric_definition: Use frozen netagents.netscale.phases: layer acceptance endpoints minus fastest per-layer work; exclude layer0 from handoff mean (layers1-3). Report join excess/store reads separately. Inspect traces for crew formation; do not infer causality from T alone.
limits: Only three seeds and two team sizes; do not change predictions, prompts or strategy using test results.
No matched width8 single-agent LLM run; do not import width16 T1=330 to compute eta or solo speedup. Report T8/T16 and reference ratios instead.
Execution includes the committed before-every-call history trimming fix from 0b8335b; record trims and context lengths.
About 70 million tokens is an estimate, not a measured cost or guaranteed cap.
Integer validator does not enforce apply queries for arbitrary strategies; audit actual four-step chains.
